Name: Workflow Automation Lite
Author: Packrat

Actions.Name: Run Sequence
Actions.Tooltip: Runs a list of steps in order on one press. Open programs, press keys, wait, and open links.

Description: Turn the same five things you do every morning into one press. Build a list of steps in order, up to five of them: open a program, press a key combination, wait a moment for something to load, open a link. Then press once and watch it work. The key counts the steps off as it goes, so you can see how far along it is at a glance, and if a step goes wrong it stops there and tells you which one instead of carrying on regardless. Waiting is a real step rather than a guess, which is what makes it possible to open something slow and then type into it once it is actually ready.
